title: COPE: Composable Performance Emulation for Mixture-of-Experts Offloading Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.33404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLMs scale, mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity while keeping per-token computation manageable through sparse expert activation. This sparsity also enables memory-efficient deployment by retaining most expert weights in CPU memory and transferring or executing only the routed experts on demand. Existing MoE offloading systems typically target specific model-platform configurations, yet differences in model sparsity, CPU and GPU throughput, VRAM capacity, and host-device bandwidth can change the policy ranking. Because implementing and exhaustively evaluating all candidate policies incurs substantial engineering cost, efficiently selecting the best-performing policy for each model-platform configuration remains a key challenge for practical MoE offloading. translated_title: COPE：面向专家混合模型卸载策略的可组合性能仿真
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）规模的扩大，专家混合架构通过稀疏专家激活，在增加模型容量的同时保持每令牌计算量可控。这种稀疏性也支持内存高效的部署方式，即将大部分专家权重保留在CPU内存中，仅按需传输或执行被路由到的专家。现有的MoE卸载系统通常只针对特定的模型-平台配置，然而模型稀疏度、CPU和GPU吞吐量、显存容量以及主机-设备带宽等方面的差异可能会改变策略的性能排序。由于实现并穷举评估所有候选策略会产生巨大的工程成本，如何高效地为每种模型-平台配置选择性能最优的策略，仍然是实际MoE卸载面临的关键挑战。我们提出了COPE（可组合卸载策略仿真器），它能够为目标模型-平台配置选择性能最优的MoE卸载策略。
tldr: COPE是一个可组合的性能仿真器，能够高效模拟并选出针对特定模型-平台配置性能最优的MoE卸载策略，避免了逐一实现和穷举评估所有候选策略的巨大工程成本。
en_tdlr: COPE is a composable performance emulator that efficiently identifies the best-performing MoE offloading policy for a given model-platform configuration, avoiding the substantial engineering cost of implementing and exhaustively evaluating all candidate policies.
